WANDIMOD-STRIFE.title: Strife
WANDIMOD-STRIFE.description: Temporary Max HP. Gaining Strife raises your Max HP and heals you by the same amount. All Strife is lost when combat ends.
WANDIMOD-VENGEANCE.title: Vengeance
WANDIMOD-VENGEANCE.description: Gain a stack whenever you lose HP. Each stack increases your attack damage by 2%. Whenever 7 stacks accumulate: consume up to 4 stacks (leave at least 1) and add a [gold]Conquer all lands![/gold] to your hand.
WANDIMOD-CONQUERALLLANDS.title: Conquer all lands!
WANDIMOD-CONQUERALLLANDS.description: A 0-cost Attack generated whenever 7 Vengeance stacks accumulate: deals damage to ALL enemies, including a portion of your missing HP. Retain. Exhaust.
